lobby.invite: 📲 Everyone plays on their OWN phone: tap Invite in the top bar, send the link, and friends appear here as they open it.
menu.title: How in-sync is this room?
menu.intro: Each round one psychic secretly sees a target on a spectrum and gives ONE clue that sits right there. The room argues and turns the dial. 7 rounds, score the group. 3+ players.
menu.lobbyText: Tap Invite. The psychic sees the target on THEIR phone and types one clue; everyone else shares the dial. No looking away.
peek.body: {name} is the psychic. Everyone else, look away! Psychic: hold to peek at the target, think of ONE clue that sits exactly there, then hide it and say the clue out loud.
peek.hold: 👁 Hold to peek at the target
peek.given: Clue given — hand the room the dial
guess.title: Where does the clue land?
guess.body: Argue it out, drag the needle, then lock it in.
verdict.sync: 📡 In sync! You people hang out too much.
verdict.none: 📴 Do you even know each other?
net.psychicBody: Everyone else has a blank dial. Peek the target, type ONE clue that sits right there.
net.lookAt: Look at them, not their phone. A clue is coming.
net.psyWatch: You can watch the needle. Do not hint.
net.guessBody: Argue, drag the needle, lock it in.
